Ambidextrous Growth:Increase the chance of long-term innovation success by widening the funnel and diversifying inputs for increased cross-pollination. Build short-term diversity through M&A. Build ambidextrous sustain and build operations to enable both forms of growth and expand the group into a portfolio of businesses with scientific, long-term value generation.

Adaptability:Build the capability to respond to opportunities in the Sustaining business. Build the NAG Library to be flexible and open to new business models. Continue to experiment with AD whilst aggressively exploring in this area. Make a serious investment in HPC services and absorb risk in B2.

Differentiation:Develop world class central strategic support, including innovation and market analysis, as a service available to a diverse set of businesses in the group. Develop world class M&A evaluation and execution processes and a partnership program that spans S1-B2.
